design_blocker.summary: The multi-diamond-witness case of the K-diamond consistency argument needs a bridge hypothesis beyond h_Kdia (K-diamond) to convert a derived fact of shape '(diamond A) -> (box B)' into 'box (A -> B)'. This is exactly the Fischer-Servi axiom Idb in the reference mechanization; it is not in this phase's (or Phase 2b's) scoped hypothesis list.
design_blocker.reference: ianshil/CK, theories/Completeness_th/general_th_completeness.v, Box case, lines ~211-249 (fetched via raw.githubusercontent.com/ianshil/CK/main/..., confirmed present at commit reachable via github.com/ianshil/CK on 2026-07-14)
design_blocker.reference_axiom_used: Idb A B := (diamond A -> box B) -> box (A -> B), defined at theories/GHC/CKH.v:34, invoked at general_th_completeness.v:231 via 'apply Ax ; right ; right ; eexists ; eexists ; right ; reflexivity'
design_blocker.reference_axiom_matches_our_Kd: theories/GHC/CKH.v:25 'Kd A B : F = (box (A -> B)) -> ((diamond A) -> diamond B)' matches our h_Kdia exactly and IS available (part of base CK MAxioms, used at general_th_completeness.v:216 'apply K_rule in K1' and elsewhere) -- Kd/h_Kdia alone is confirmed insufficient by this same file for the box-witness existence lemma.
design_blocker.recommended_fix: Add h_Idb : forall A B, Axioms (((diamond A).imp (box B)).imp (box (A.imp B))) as an explicit parametric hypothesis to box_witness_pair_underivable and canonical_box_witness (Phase 2b). Re-plan via /revise 480 or a narrowly-scoped /research 480 --hard --lit pass before re-dispatching this phase.
design_blocker.also_check: Phase 2c (canonical_diamond_witness) should be checked for whether it needs the dual axiom Cd A B := diamond(A or B) -> (diamond A or diamond B) (theories/GHC/CKH.v:33) -- not confirmed either way this dispatch; the diamond case of general_th_completeness.v was not read closely enough to rule it in or out.
